pending.headline: Google Replaces Chat Gems with Anthropic-Standard 'Skills'

items.title: Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats
items.snippet: Google is replacing Gems with "Skills" in Gemini chat. Skills are detailed, reusable prompts that users invoke by typing "/" or that Gemini runs automatically. The format is based on an open standard from Anthropic. Gems will be phased out starting in November, with existing ones migrating automatically. The article Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats…

pending.summary: Google is phasing out customized chat 'Gems' in favor of 'Skills,' reusable and detailed prompts invoked via slash commands or automated agent execution. The new format is built on an open standard originally introduced by Anthropic.
